Create a kernelcomm_result object

Source: R/classes.R
create_kernelcomm_result.Rd

Helper function to create a valid kernelcomm_result object.

create_kernelcomm_result(
  h,
  observed,
  permutations,
  coords,
  gene1_name,
  gene2_name,
  sample_id,
  seed,
  n_cells,
  call
)

Arguments

h

Numeric vector of bandwidths

observed

Numeric vector of observed Moran's I

permutations

Numeric matrix of permutation results

coords

Matrix of coordinates

gene1_name

Character. Gene 1 name

gene2_name

Character. Gene 2 name

sample_id

Character. Sample identifier

seed

Numeric. Random seed

n_cells

Integer. Number of cells

call

Language. Function call

Value

kernelcomm_result object

Examples

res <- create_kernelcomm_result(
  h = c(0.05, 0.1),
  observed = c(0.02, 0.01),
  permutations = matrix(rnorm(20), nrow = 2),
  coords = matrix(runif(20), ncol = 2),
  gene1_name = "CD274", gene2_name = "PDCD1",
  sample_id = "example", seed = 1, n_cells = 10,
  call = quote(create_kernelcomm_result())
)
res
#> multiScaleAC result
#> ===================
#> Sample: example 
#> Gene pair: CD274 x PDCD1 
#> Bandwidths: 2 values from 0.05 to 0.1 
#> Permutations: 10 
#> Cells: 10 
#> Significance: Not computed (use compute_significance())
